about.title: We connect education and technology
about.body: COVE Edu brings new learning experiences to schools, universities, companies, and public institutions through AI and coding education and edtech solutions.
about.body_2: We design the teaching and build the tools that run it. We meet students every week at our Mapo campus, and what we learn in that room goes back into Cove Studio.

areas.title: From the classroom to the platform, one continuous line
areas.education_body: Structured AI and software courses for students
areas.education_detail: Block coding through Python and AI, on one curriculum that keeps going as a student's grade and level change.
areas.solution_body: An AI and coding platform, with the content to teach from
areas.solution_detail: From a student running their first line of code to a teacher running the room — everything an academy or school needs, in one environment.
areas.enterprise_body: Custom AI programs and lectures for universities, companies, and government
areas.enterprise_detail: Designed around your actual work and your actual data. We stay past the lecture, through adoption.

studio.title: A coding platform that started in a real classroom
studio.lead: A student's practice and a teacher's class run in the same place.
studio.point_run_title: Python that runs in the browser
studio.point_run_body: No install, no setup. First line of code three minutes into the lesson.
studio.point_grade_body: Students see the result immediately, and get a hint exactly where they're stuck.
studio.point_live_body: Teachers watch the work as it happens, and reach a student before the hand goes up.
studio.point_data_title: Progress by class and by student
studio.point_data_body: What's landed and what hasn't, so the next lesson plans itself.
